question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The allies / of the government / decided to / withdrew all support.
solution:
​The correct answer is** '****withdrew all support'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'withdraw all support' **should be used instead of **'withdrew all support'. **
 
• We know that after '**to**' infinitive the base form of the verb is used.
 
 
• *Example: So many things in life seem** to be **a test of some kind.*

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The allies of the government decided to **withdraw all support.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• यहां, **'withdrew all support'** के बजाय **'withdraw all support'** का उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• हम जानते हैं कि** infinitive 'to'** के बाद **Verb** के **Base form **का प्रयोग होता है।
 
 
• *Example: So many things in life seem **to be** a test of some kind.*
